site.name: American Eagle Mine
site.componentDetail: Named historic mine locality on Montezuma topographic mapping
overview: American Eagle Mine is a named historic mine locality in Summit County on the Montezuma topographic quadrangle, in the high country near Lenawee Mountain and Arapahoe Basin. The mapped feature is at approximately 39.62249, -105.86862.
Remnant uses the mapped mine locality for identification only. The record does not claim that a mine opening is currently accessible, open, or safe.
